g.text: Only one thing in the whole pipeline runs out of CPU, and it is not ours
Local figures from per-thread processor time; far-end figures sampled from /proc during the same transfers. Both panels share one axis.
Windows: Dell Latitude 7490, i5-8350U (4 cores / 8 threads, 15 W) · Linux: Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U (16 threads) · Thunderbolt networking, MTU 65330, link 20 Gbit/s
